text:
Lina (Partnerships): looping in legal & product — Nimbus has okayed redistribution of quantized weights but wants visibility on marketplace SKU and a joint PR. Main asks: attribution, export self-classification, and a 10% redistribution revenue share. Thoughts?

Matt (Legal): need the exact license they propose. Is it an ODL-like grant or custom? If it allows commercial redistribution we need indemnity and export controls spelled out. Also please confirm the legal entity name for KYC.

Anika (Product): from product: we need the ability to pin model version and host a "redwood-verified" badge. Nimbus wants a co-branded tile and a short blurb. That part is ok if marketing approves messaging.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): technical: they will provide FP16 and int8 quant files. For packaging we need a manifest with model_id, quant_levels, checksums, and a few perf numbers (latency/cost vs baseline). Can we ask for a sample inference script too?

Eva (Compliance): check export control — if training data has restricted tech or provenance there may be limitations. I need them to fill our export questionnaire and provide org registration docs.

Lina (Partnerships): proposed contract snippet to float to Nimbus: "Distributor may redistribute Model in compiled/quantized form subject to: (i) attribution to Nimbus; (ii) no redistribution to sanctioned parties; (iii) 10% gross revenue share on marketplace sales; (iv) mutual PR coordination 30 days prior to public announcement." Can someone vet?

Matt (Legal): suggest tighten (iii) to net revenue after payment processing and taxes. Add an audit right (quarterly or 1x/year with standard notice). Define "sanctioned parties" via SCHEDULE A rather than free text. Also want a 12-month initial term with automatic renewal and a termination for convenience with 60 days notice.

Anika (Product): timeline ask from Nimbus: they requested marketplace listing + joint blog on April 15. Dependencies: contract signed, packaging uploaded, E2E perf tests pass, and marketing signoff. Is that realistic?

Sanjay (Eng-ML): I'll run the perf harness on dedicated infra and share numbers by EOD Friday. Need sample prompts and the quant files when they upload.

Lina (Partnerships): I'll draft an LOI today and ask Nimbus to complete the export questionnaire. @marketplace-bot can you provisionally reserve SKU nimbus-v1-qa? :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Reserved SKU nimbus-v1-qa for 7 days. Use /release-sku to free early.

Eva (Compliance): KYC and export questionnaire must be completed before we sign. I'll DM the checklist to their legal.

Lina (Partnerships): added their PM ben@nimbus.ai to the thread. Ben, can you drop the model manifest + proposed license PDF?

Ben (Nimbus PM): sharing manifest now: https://files.nimbus.ai/nimbus-v1-manifest.json — license is a custom "Nimbus Community Redistribution 1.0". Will DM legal. Also we'd prefer 8% revenue share but open to negotiation.

Matt (Legal): uploading their license to review queue. 8% vs 10% — we'll counter to 9% net revenue, with audit rights and a defined accounting cadence.

Lina (Partnerships): noted. Any last blockers from infra or compliance before I send LOI?

Sanjay (Eng-ML): none from infra; preliminary run shows +3% median latency vs our baseline and cost roughly flat. Good to proceed with QA.

Eva (Compliance): outstanding items: completed export questionnaire and proof of org registration. Block until returned.

Lina (Partnerships): OK — I'll send LOI with provisional 9% net clause, audit right, and 30-day PR notice. Will cc marketing. Back with updates.
